explanation: God as ruler over all nations with full power and authority, especially mentioned in connection with the judgment against Judah.
The time when God intervenes in history to judge sin and restore justice.
Description of God's ability to see everything, including hidden sins that cannot escape his gaze.
The intense anger God shows against disobedience and idolatry in Jerusalem.
The religious acts or animals used to bring offerings to God, here criticized as empty without true piety.
The state of fear and obedient quiet people should have when facing judgment from God.
